_doc: Adjudicated NOT-APPLICABLE verdicts consumed by build_coverage_matrix.js. Keyed param -> symbol. A symbol here is excluded from that parameter's DENOMINATOR on the coverage page (not counted as covered, and not counted as missing). Optional "from"/"to" (YYYY-MM-DD) bound the verdict to a date range; absent means all dates. Every entry carries per-name evidence — no category rules.

SPICEJET.evidence: screener.in consolidated quarterly: Operating Profit populated in 13 of 13 shown quarters (Dec-2025 = -181) AND Depreciation populated in 13 of 13 (Dec-2025 = 146). Our schema's EBIT = OP - Depreciation, so it derives cleanly (-327). Our sf_revop holds op in only 4 of 22 quarters, so `op` is a gap here too.
SPICEJET.next: P3 fill via the revop ledger; verify one quarter against the filed PDF before trusting a derived series.
SPICEJET.verdict: C4 — FILLABLE, source has both inputs

_insurers_op_present_dep_zero.evidence: screener.in shows Operating Profit populated in 13 of 13 quarters but Depreciation as literal 0 in every quarter. Under the IRDAI account format depreciation is not broken out of 'Operating Expenses related to Insurance Business'. A 0 here is therefore a NOT-DISCLOSED sentinel, not a measured zero (feedback-zero-is-a-no-base-sentinel / feedback-falsy-sentinel-needs-truthy-test). Deriving EBIT = OP - 0 = OP would silently assert 'this insurer has no depreciation', which no filing says.
_insurers_op_present_dep_zero.next: Read one actual filed result per name and establish whether the format discloses depreciation at all. If it does not, these are C1 (report-absent) exactly like the banks. If it does, C4.

_no_op_values_either.evidence: screener.in carries the 'Operating Profit' ROW LABEL for these (which is why they separate from the 33 banking-format names) but no non-zero values in the quarters shown. So the aggregator does not answer the question either way.
_no_op_values_either.next: Primary filing read per name (NSE archive first, then BSE PDF + vision-fill per runbook 17b). LAKSHVILAS is a merged bank (into DBS Nov-2020) so expect a truncated series; treat its post-merger months as C3, not C4.

_p2_findings_ebit_nonbanking._note: Phase 2, 2026-08-16. The 13 candidates that are NOT banking-format. screener.in read per name. NONE are adjudicated yet — recorded so the next session does not re-derive, and so nobody 'fills' these from a sentinel.

_p3_nbfc_decision.DATA_vs_PAGE_DIVERGENCE_KNOWN: This marks the COVERAGE PAGE N/A. The underlying sf_revop still holds ebit for ~795 lender quarters (784 of them produced by our own XBRL parse, not by aggregators — measured), so the backtest engine can still screen on them. Aligning the data means fixing build_revop.py's filer detection and rebuilding from the XBRL cache, which does not exist on this Mac. Recorded as an OPEN follow-up, not silently left.
_p3_nbfc_decision.DHFL: screener returns HTTP 404 (delisted/merged into PIRAMALFIN). Not adjudicated here; its 3 alias-shadowed ebit quarters remain a separate open item.
_p3_nbfc_decision._decision: USER 2026-08-16: show NBFCs exactly as screener does — no EBIT, same as banks.
_p3_nbfc_decision._method: screener.in's OWN LAYOUT is the criterion, checked PER NAME across all 54 NSE-NBFC-flagged symbols. Screener replaces "Operating Profit"/"OPM %" with "Financing Profit"/"Financing Margin %" for a lender, exactly as it does for banks.
_p3_nbfc_decision.\u26a0\ufe0f_why_per_name_mattered: A "financials are lenders" category rule would have been WRONG on 23 of 58 names. screener treats asset managers (HDFCAMC, UTIAMC, NAM-INDIA, ABSLAMC, ICICIAMC), brokers/wealth (ANGELONE, MOTILALOFS, NUVAMA, 360ONE, JMFINANCIL), holding companies (BAJAJHLDNG, BAJAJFINSV, TATAINVEST, IDFC) and PIRAMALFIN/EDELWEISS/RELCAPITAL/DHANI as ORDINARY companies — fee businesses, not lenders — so they keep a real Operating Profit and keep EBIT. The NSE NBFC flag also mis-flagged WESTLIFE (McDonald's India), PAGEIND (Jockey) and RAJESHEXPO (jewellery); screener correctly calls all three ordinary.

_p3_root_cause_ebit.BLOCKED_ON: Per-name format determination needs the XBRL itself. There is NO local _xbrl_cache on this Mac (the path in scan_xbrl_nature.py is the old Windows one), so this is a fetch campaign, not a code change. Do NOT mark these N/A from the sf_revop pattern alone — that is exactly the circular inference §63 was written about.
_p3_root_cause_ebit.NEXT: Fetch XBRL per name for the 107 ebit-gap and 67 op-gap names, branch with build_revop's own metrics_for() detection, and record the format per name. Names that resolve to LI/GI/bank/NBFC become C1; industrial names with missing quarters become C4 fills. SPICEJET is already confirmed industrial and fillable.
_p3_root_cause_ebit._finding: THE WHOLE ebit GAP IS EXPLAINED BY FILER FORMAT, and it is documented in our own XBRL extractor — scripts/build_revop.py metrics_for(). Found 2026-08-16 while walking the §57 route ladder. This supersedes the aggregator-based reasoning: build_revop reads the XBRL of the actual filings and branches on tags, so it is a statement about the filings, not about our coverage.

ebit_is_None_for_FOUR_formats.bank: detected by InterestEarned + OperatingProfitBeforeProvisionAndContingencies; ':261 # ebit not reproduced for banks'. rev = InterestEarned, op = pre-provision profit.
ebit_is_None_for_FOUR_formats.general_insurer_IRDAI_GI: detected by the PremiumEarned tag; returns ebit=None (:250). rev = PremiumEarned + investments; op = rev - OperatingExpenses - NonOperatingExpense. e.g. ICICIGI, GODIGIT, STARHEALTH, NIACL.
ebit_is_None_for_FOUR_formats.life_insurer_IRDAI_LI: detected by the NetPremiumIncome tag; returns ebit=None (build_revop.py:236). rev = NetPremiumIncome + IncomeFromInvestmentsNet + InvestmentIncome; op = ProfitLossBeforeTax - other income. e.g. HDFCLIFE, ICICIPRULI, SBILIFE, LICI.
ebit_is_None_for_FOUR_formats.nbfc_ind_as: detected by InterestEarned with NO bank op tag; ':276 # ebit not reproduced for NBFCs'. op = PBET + FC + Dep - OI - OtherRevenueFromOperations.

_p3_root_cause_ebit.ebit_is_computed_ONLY_for_industrial: ebit = ProfitBeforeExceptionalItemsAndTax + FinanceCosts - OtherIncome (build_revop.py:280), i.e. operating profit after depreciation. For a bank or NBFC FinanceCosts IS the core cost of the business, so the formula would not mean 'earnings before interest' — consistent with the user's option-A decision.
_p3_root_cause_ebit.what_it_implies_for_the_remaining_1251_e: The 12 unresolved non-banking names are LI/GI insurers — same structural class as the banks. Many of the 94 'has-ebit-somewhere' names are NBFCs/financials (SHRIRAMFIN, SAMMAANCAP, 360ONE, POONAWALLA, BAJFINANCE, CHOLAFIN, MUTHOOTFIN, LICHSGFIN, PFC, RECLTD, HDFCAMC, SBICARD ...), whose ebit plausibly STOPS at an Ind-AS/NBFC format transition rather than being a hole.
_p3_root_cause_ebit.why_this_is_better_evidence: It names the XBRL tags that distinguish the formats, and the rev/op values these branches produce are Trendlyne-exact per format (ICICIGI Q1FY27 rev 7088.22 / op 522.10; HDFCLIFE Q1FY27 con 33758.51). It is not an inference from our own gaps (§63).

_second_reader_status._rule: DATA_RUNBOOK §63e — an exclusion must rest on evidence ABOUT THE COMPANY and be tested on a sample against 2-3 sources. §63 is USER-CAUGHT precedent: inferring 'does not file' from our own gaps was 63% wrong.
_second_reader_status.coverage_of_rule: §63e asks for a SAMPLE against 2-3 sources; reader_1 is per-name across all 33 and reader_2 samples two bank types. Bar met, but NOT per-name for reader_2 — moneycontrol blocks scripted fetches and its URL codes are not derivable, so a full sweep needs 33 manual navigations.
_second_reader_status.implications_test_\u00a763e_rule_3: PASSED, and it caught a real error. The selected population is exactly 'banking-format filers' — a real accounting-format class, not an absurd one. Critically, the 13 non-banking names a category rule would have swept in (12 insurers + SPICEJET + LAKSHVILAS) WERE caught and excluded, ~670 cells kept visible.
_second_reader_status.outstanding: 31 of 33 still have no per-name second reader. Upgrade opportunistically; the format claim is not in doubt, the per-name discipline is what is incomplete.
_second_reader_status.reader_1_all_33: screener.in, fetched PER NAME 2026-08-16. Banking-format filers show 'Financing Profit'/'Financing Margin %' where every other filer shows 'Operating Profit'/'OPM %'. Neither layout carries an EBIT row — screener publishes no EBIT for ANY company; ours is derived as OP - Depreciation.
_second_reader_status.reader_2_sampled: moneycontrol.com, 2 of 33 read in full: HDFCBANK (private) and SBIN (public sector). Both serve the RBI banking format with no EBIT row. HDFCBANK ties out numerically: its PPOP 30,996 == our sf_revop op_con 30996.0 for 20260630.

Its FIRST consolidated filing (17-Oct-2024, quarter ended 2024-09-30) carries note 2: 'The figures presented in all the comparative periods in the consolidated financial results are same as presented in the standalone financial results.' The trigger is not a subsidiary at all but a 49% ASSOCIATE - Dr. Reddy's and Nestle Health Science Ltd, associate w.e.f. 01-Aug-2024, consolidated by the equity method under s.129(3); the con P&L's 'Share of (Profit)/Loss of an Associate' line is 37.2 in Q Sep-2024 and NIL in every comparative. Purina PetCare India belongs to Nestle S.A., never to Nestle India. Before the floor: the audited annuals for CY2015 (headline itself reads '(Standalone)'), CY2018, CY2022 and the 15-month FY24, plus the Jun-2024 quarterly, all carry zero consolidated content. This is the name whose NSE list was thinnest - 9 rows across 60 quarters - and it is now closed on the filings themselves rather than on that index.

NESTLEIND.reader_1: Nestle India. Second-reader filing evidence 2026-08-18, and the company declares the defect itself. Its FIRST consolidated filing (17-Oct-2024, quarter ended 2024-09-30) carries note 2: 'The figures presented in all the comparative periods in the consolidated financial results are same as presented in the standalone financial results.' The trigger is not a subsidiary at all but a 49% ASSOCIATE - Dr. Reddy's and Nestle Health Science Ltd, associate w.e.f. 01-Aug-2024, consolidated by the equity method under s.129(3); the con P&L's 'Share of (Profit)/Loss of an Associate' line is 37.2 in Q Sep-2024 and NIL in every comparative. Purina PetCare India belongs to Nestle S.A., never to Nestle India. Before the floor: the audited annuals for CY2015 (headline itself reads '(Standalone)'), CY2018, CY2022 and the 15-month FY24, plus the Jun-2024 quarterly, all carry zero consolidated content. This is the name whose NSE list was thinnest - 9 rows across 60 quarters - and it is now closed on the filings themselves rather than on that index.

Jubilant Ingrevia Ltd Q4FY21 result -- its FIRST-EVER filing (NSE stream: 32 quarterly rows, earliest to=20210331 from=20210101, filed 08-Jun-2021, Consolidated AND Non-Consolidated the same day). JUBLINGREA.reader_2: SAME FILING, independent statement: PDF page 17, 'Statement of Consolidated Audited Assets and Liabilities', column 'As at 31 March 2020 (Audited)' -- TOTAL ASSETS 5 lakh, being cash 5 and nothing else; every other asset line a dash. JUBLINGREA.why: Not a data gap. The engine returns null because the lookback reaches into quarters in which the entity had no operations, and the filer published those quarters as nil. Both the con AND std families are marked because the shell fact is basis-independent -- the standalone columns are dashes too.

Jubilant Ingrevia Ltd Q4FY21 result -- its FIRST-EVER filing (NSE stream: 32 quarterly rows, earliest to=20210331 from=20210101, filed 08-Jun-2021, Consolidated AND Non-Consolidated the same day). PDF page 16, 'Statement of Consolidated Audited Results for the Quarter and Year ended 31 March 2021', prints FIVE columns: Quarter Ended 31-Mar-2021 / 31-Dec-2020 / 31-Mar-2020, and Year Ended 31-Mar-2021 / 31-Mar-2020. The year-ago columns are GEOMETRICALLY PRESENT and every line in them is a dash -- revenue nil, all expense lines nil, Net Profit nil for both Q3FY21 (Dec-2020) and Q4FY20 (Mar-2020). The FY2020 year column carries a single 'Others' expense of 17 lakh and a net loss of (17) lakh, EPS (3.31), paid-up capital 5 lakh.
JUBLINGREA.reader_2: SAME FILING, independent statement: PDF page 17, 'Statement of Consolidated Audited Assets and Liabilities', column 'As at 31 March 2020 (Audited)' -- TOTAL ASSETS 5 lakh, being cash 5 and nothing else; every other asset line a dash. Equity share capital 5, other equity (17), total equity attributable to equity holders (12). A balance sheet with 5 lakh of assets is a shell, not an operating company: the demerged Life Science Ingredients business had not yet vested.
JUBLINGREA.why: Not a data gap. The engine returns null because the lookback reaches into quarters in which the entity had no operations, and the filer published those quarters as nil. Filling them with 0 would be 'what was printed' but would make every dependent parameter garbage: a YoY or TTM growth against a zero base is undefined, which is the same reason NSLNISP was adjudicated C-zerobase. Both the con AND std families are marked because the shell fact is basis-independent -- the standalone columns are dashes too.

JUBLINGREA.our_data: Measured 2026-08-18: docs/sf_fundamentals.json holds 22 rows for JUBLINGREA, 20210331 -> 20260630, with NO missing cells at all -- std PAT, con PAT, both announce dates, revenue and op present on every row, and con genuinely DIFFERING from std throughout (38.59 vs 54.36, 138.17 vs 168.26, ...), i.e. real consolidation, not a std copy. JUBLINGREA.reader_1: PRIMARY FILING, read 2026-08-18. Jubilant Ingrevia Ltd Q4FY21 result -- its FIRST-EVER filing (NSE stream: 32 quarterly rows, earliest to=20210331 from=20210101, filed 08-Jun-2021, Consolidated AND Non-Consolidated the same day). PDF page 16, 'Statement of Consolidated Audited Results for the Quarter and Year ended 31 March 2021', prints FIVE columns: Quarter Ended 31-Mar-2021 / 31-Dec-2020 / 31-Mar-2020, and Year Ended 31-Mar-2021 / 31-Mar-2020. The year-ago columns are GEOMETRICALLY PRESENT and every line in them is a dash -- revenue nil, all expense lines nil, Net Profit nil for both Q3FY21 (Dec-2020) and Q4FY20 (Mar-2020). The FY2020 year column carries a single 'Others' expense of 17 lakh and a net loss of (17) lakh, EPS (3.31), paid-up capital 5 lakh.
JUBLINGREA.reader_2: SAME FILING, independent statement: PDF page 17, 'Statement of Consolidated Audited Assets and Liabilities', column 'As at 31 March 2020 (Audited)' -- TOTAL ASSETS 5 lakh, being cash 5 and nothing else; every other asset line a dash. Equity share capital 5, other equity (17), total equity attributable to equity holders (12). A balance sheet with 5 lakh of assets is a shell, not an operating company: the demerged Life Science Ingredients business had not yet vested.
JUBLINGREA.why: Not a data gap. The engine returns null because the lookback reaches into quarters in which the entity had no operations, and the filer published those quarters as nil. Filling them with 0 would be 'what was printed' but would make every dependent parameter garbage: a YoY or TTM growth against a zero base is undefined, which is the same reason NSLNISP was adjudicated C-zerobase. Both the con AND std families are marked because the shell fact is basis-independent -- the standalone columns are dashes too.
